```{r, echo = F, warning = F}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(msa))
source("~/VHH/lib/utilities.R")

top_groups <- function(results, column_id){
  return(table(results[[column_id]])[order(table(results[[column_id]]), decreasing = T)])
}
```


```{r, echo = F, warning = F}
tmp <- read.csv("~/Downloads/S19-NTGAV-Family-MMseqs2-H80-recluster12Mar24.csv", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
```


```{r}
results <- data.frame()

for (nm in unique(tmp$centroid_sequence_id)){
  tmp_frame <- tmp[tmp$centroid_sequence_id == nm,]
  sequences <- Biostrings::AAStringSet(tmp_frame$member_VHH)
  # Perform multiple sequence alignment
  msa_result <- msa::msa(sequences, method = "ClustalOmega", verbose = F, order = "input")
  # Store aligned results
  tmp_frame$Aligned_Members <- as.character(msa_result@unmasked)
  results <- rbind(results, tmp_frame)
}

results$Aligned_Members <- gsub("-", "X", results$Aligned_Members)
```

```{r}
write.csv(results[,c("centroid_sequence_id", 
                     "centroid_junction_aa",
                     "member_sequence_id",
                     "member_junction_aa",
                     "centroid_clone_id",
                     "member_clone_id",
                     "centroid_VHH",
                     "Aligned_Members")], file = "~/Downloads/S19-NTGAV-Family-MMseqs2-H80-aligned-recluster14Mar24.csv", row.names = F)
```
